# has sexual orientation

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasSexualOrientation`](gmeow-hasSexualOrientation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasSexualOrientation>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/sexuality`](../../slices/sexuality.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a person to a self-asserted sexual-orientation facet. Non-functional and contextual; a superseded one is kept with [`gmeow:displayable`](gmeow-displayable.md) false, never deleted. MUST NOT be inferred from [`gmeow:hasRomanticOrientation`](gmeow-hasRomanticOrientation.md), [`gmeow:hasGenderIdentity`](gmeow-hasGenderIdentity.md), [`gmeow:sexAssignedAtBirth`](gmeow-sexAssignedAtBirth.md), pronouns or honorifics.

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Person`](../classes/gmeow-Person.md) -> [`gmeow:SexualOrientation`](../classes/gmeow-SexualOrientation.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to attach one or more self-asserted sexual-orientation facets to a person — non-functional by design, so concurrent or time-scoped orientations and a superseded prior orientation all coexist on the same person.

### Avoid when

- Avoid making this functional or deleting a superseded value (mark it [`gmeow:displayable`](gmeow-displayable.md) false instead), and avoid asserting it from any other axis — romantic orientation, gender identity, sex assigned at birth, pronouns, or honorifics are co-equal and never derive it.

### How to use

- Link the person to a [`gmeow:SexualOrientation`](../classes/gmeow-SexualOrientation.md) facet rather than a bare value, so determinacy, sensitivity, and standpoint ride on the facet; keep prior assertions with [`gmeow:displayable`](gmeow-displayable.md) false and let self-assertion override any attributed claim on the statement layer.

- ex:lillith [`gmeow:hasSexualOrientation`](gmeow-hasSexualOrientation.md) ex:lillithSexOrient.
